weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入獅子座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往獅子座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 今天，牡羊座，是你作為英雄閃耀的時刻。你不需要服裝或斗篷來對某人的生活產生有意義的影響。採取主動，即使不是你指定的行動時間。真正的英雄是那些無論情況如何都能隨機應變並在需要時採取行動的人。
aries.horoscope_en: Today, Aries, is your moment to shine as a hero. You don’t need a costume or a cape to create a meaningful impact in someone’s life. Take the initiative, even if it’s not your designated time to act. Real heroes are those who rise to the occasion and take action when it’s needed, no matter the situation.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，今天將為你帶來豐富的享受！請記住，您不需要花錢就能享受美好時光。事實上，用現金來衡量樂趣可能不是最好的方法。反思您在追求更多收入時遇到的權衡。今天你周圍充滿活力，鼓勵你拓寬視野，探索其他快樂途徑。
taurus.horoscope_en: Today promises a wealth of enjoyment for you, Taurus! Remember, you don't need to spend money to have a good time. In fact, using cash as a measure of fun might not be the best approach. Reflect on the trade-offs you encounter while chasing after more income. There's an energetic vibe surrounding you today, encouraging you to broaden your horizons and explore alternative avenues for joy.

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，請記住，這不僅關係到您今天的活動，也關係到您的陪伴。你周圍有一種充滿活力的能量，你可以利用它來取得積極的成果。盡情享受，別忘了分享微笑。有了正確的動力，您就可以在實現自己的願望方面取得重大進展。與周圍的人互動並利用集體支持的力量。
gemini.horoscope_en: Gemini, keep in mind that it's not just about your activities today, but the company you keep. There's a vibrant energy surrounding you that you can harness for positive outcomes. Enjoy yourself and don't forget to share a smile. With the right motivation, you can achieve significant strides toward your aspirations. Engage with those around you and tap into the power of collective support.

cancer.horoscope_en: Today may bring a challenging lesson your way, Cancer. The more impactful the message feels, the more crucial it is for your growth. Embrace setbacks with grace, as the person who seems to push you down might also be the one to lift you back up. Expect some unexpected turns throughout the day. Stay adaptable and take everything in stride.

leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you have an abundance of energy to keep your passions ignited. Expect to encounter significant opportunities that will require you to act with confidence. Embrace the extra responsibilities that come your way, as your strong sense of self will empower you to lead effectively. Just be mindful to navigate these situations without overshadowing others.

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，今天要小心謹慎；一個小小的失誤就可能導致揮之不去的頭痛。避免承擔不必要的風險。氣氛充滿了能量和信心，但在你跳入未知之前，請停下來重新考慮。保持你的安全網緊密相連。擁抱你的個性，專注於培養你的內在力量，而不是展現魯莽的一面。
virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, be cautious today; a single misstep could lead to a lingering headache. Avoid taking unnecessary risks. The atmosphere is charged with energy and confidence, but before you leap into the unknown, pause and reconsider. Keep your safety net close. Embrace your individuality and focus on nurturing your inner strength rather than showcasing a reckless side.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，成為理想自我的旅程是一條曲折的道路。擁抱你的真實本性，因為你無法簡單地改變你的核心本質。您面臨的每一次互動和每一次挑戰都會塑造您的身份。對自己的進步感到自豪，但也要承認未來仍有顯著的內在成長。考慮花一些時間冥想或獨處來反思。
libra.horoscope_en: The journey to becoming your ideal self is a winding path, Libra. Embrace your true nature, as you cannot simply transform who you are at your core. Every interaction and each challenge you face shapes your identity. Take pride in your progress, but acknowledge that there is still significant inner growth ahead. Consider taking some time for meditation or solitude to reflect.

scorpio.horoscope: 身為天蠍座，以深情的方式與所愛的人告別是很重要的。想像一下，每次您離開一個空間，這都可能是您最後一次在那裡。您可能沒有機會再次與這些人重新建立聯繫。今天優先考慮培養你的人際關係，因為那些親近你的人可能會渴望一點額外的認可來感到被重視和珍惜。擁抱那些在你心中佔有特殊地位的人，並向他們表達溫暖。
scorpio.horoscope_en: As a Scorpio, it's essential to part ways with your loved ones on a note of affection. Imagine that every time you leave a space, it could be your last time there. You may not have the chance to reconnect with those individuals again. Prioritize nurturing your relationships today, as those close to you may crave a little extra validation to feel valued and cherished. Embrace and show warmth to those who hold a special place in your heart.

sagittarius.horoscope_en: When you feel like you've hit a wall, you'll discover a surprising surge of energy within you. Today, Sagittarius, challenge yourself to go beyond your usual boundaries. You'll be amazed at what you can accomplish when you believe in your abilities and take that leap. You possess a vibrant force that will propel you forward, revealing that your strength is more formidable than you ever imagined.

capricorn.horoscope_en: Today, Capricorn, no matter your emotional state, it's crucial to acknowledge your missteps. Remember, you are accountable for your choices. Even if you feel like retreating, it's vital to confront your vulnerabilities head-on. Embrace a proactive approach today, taking charge of the circumstances and owning the outcomes of your decisions.

aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, Aquarius, a significant lesson awaits you, so embrace the opportunity to learn. It's crucial to keep your attitude in check, as it may otherwise dictate your actions. Be mindful that your ego might be running high; if you're not careful, you could inadvertently push others away. Consider reassessing your approach to ensure your interactions are positive.

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，花點時間反思你的浪漫關係。雖然最初的激情火花可能令人興奮，但至關重要的是建立更深層的基礎，以維持你們的關係超越最初的興奮。從一開始就專注於培養你們的連結。確保您的伴侶不僅僅是戀人，更是您可以信賴的真正朋友。
pisces.horoscope_en: Take a moment to reflect on your romantic connections, Pisces. While the initial spark of passion can be exhilarating, it's crucial to establish a deeper foundation that can sustain your relationship beyond the initial thrill. Focus on nurturing your bonds from the very beginning. Ensure that your partner is not just a lover, but also a true friend who you can rely on.
